Congresswoman’s son-in-law dies while snorkeling CHICAGO (AP) — Congresswoman Jan Schakowsky’s son-in-law has died while snorkeling during a family outing in Mexico. The Illinois Democrat, husband Robert Creamer, their nine children and grandchildren were all in Mexico when Michael McLaughlin died.
